title: Kamal, an instrument of celestial navigation in the Indian Ocean, as described by Ottoman mariners Piri Reis and Seydi Ali Reis
lineage: Inspected cited passages; retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.note: Scholar interprets Seydi Ali Reis’s 1554 text as describing an instrument used by Indian navigators to measure stellar altitude. Terminology, origin and structure are disputed; publication day and individual voyage are not established.
